statsNote: Visitor numbers cover only visitors who gave consent and are not comparable with GA4. Spam and suspicious conversations are not counted.
takeOverHint: The AI stops replying; the visitor sees no message
suspiciousBannerText: The AI is off and stays off. It is kept as evidence and cannot be deleted.

sendFailed: Sending failed. The text is still in the field.
liveSub: Refreshes every 15 s · only visitors who consented

funnel.title: Inquiry funnel
funnel.note: A visit counts at its deepest step and at every step before it, so an inquiry sent from a pop-up on a sister site also counts as a form. Sent inquiries are counted from the start of this measurement.
funnel.exitsByType: Where they leave without an inquiry

searchEngines.title: Search engines: Google and Bing
searchEngines.firstImport: The first import of Google's history (16 months) takes about 16 hours after it is switched on.
searchEngines.note: Google and Bing give totals per query and page only, never a single visitor. Their data is 2 to 3 days late (last imported day: Google {{google}}, Bing {{bing}}). Our organic visits count only visitors who consented.
searchEngines.hidden: Google hides the query of {{n}} % of clicks, so the clicks by query are not all traffic.
searchEngines.bingNoFilter: Bing has no country or device, so it is left out with that filter.
searchEngines.byEngine: Our organic visits by search engine
searchEngines.pagesNote: Clicks, impressions and queries are Google's for the page. Org. visits and inquiries are our visits that came from a search engine to that page and the inquiries sent in those visits.

rec.note: Visits are recorded only with analytics consent. A site that is switched off records nothing and the server refuses its payloads. The share is the percentage of visits with consent that are recorded; on a phone recording starts only after the visitor's first touch, scroll or key.
rec.invalid: The share must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
rec.staffText: Open the link for each site in this browser: your visits are then not recorded and not counted in the statistics. The mark stays in this browser until you remove it.

player.gone: This recording is no longer available (recordings are deleted after 60 days).
player.busy: The recordings storage does not answer right now. Try again in a minute.
player.failed: The recording could not be loaded.
player.noStyles: This page's styles were not archived: the recording plays without its design.
player.privacy: Recordings are masked: what visitors type and their names, e-mails and phones are not shown.

heat.inquiries: Page views of visits with an inquiry
heat.reachValue: to {{pct}} % of the page: {{share}} % of page views
heat.noBackground: No background for this group (its recordings are older than 60 days): only the element list is shown.
heat.noMouse: No mouse data for this device. Phones and tablets have no mouse, and recordings made before mouse tracking was switched on carry no element on a move.
heat.shown: {{pct}} % of the clicks are on the picture. The rest are on elements that appear later (a menu, dialog or gallery) and are only in the table.
heat.shownHover: {{pct}} % of the mouse time is on the picture. The rest is on elements that appear later (a menu, dialog or gallery) and is only in the table.
heat.note: Clicks add up per element across all visits of the period; red is the most clicked. Dead click: nothing happened. Rage: the same element 3+ times within a second.
heat.noteHover: Where the mouse rests longest: red = longest, blue = shortest. Desktop only; each stay counts at most 2 seconds, so a parked mouse does not skew the map.

ins.empty: No findings yet. A page type needs at least 20 page views; data is collected every day.

kind.DEAD: "{{label}}" on the {{page}} page: {{count}} clicks with no reaction ({{percent}} % of its clicks). People expect it to open something: make it clickable or change it.
kind.RAGE: "{{label}}" on the {{page}} page: clicked again and again {{count}} times. It is probably slow or broken.
kind.INQUIRY_ELEMENT: Visitors who send an inquiry often click "{{label}}" on the {{page}} page ({{percent}} % of their page views, at least twice as often as the others). Make it stand out for everyone.
kind.CTA_REACH: On the {{page}} page only {{percent}} % of page views get as far as the "{{label}}" button (at {{count}} % of the page height). Move it up or add it at the top too.
kind.LOW_REACH: On the {{page}} page only {{percent}} % of page views see the lower half of the page. Put important content higher.
